parsed.rationale: Both `ShowContainerProtocol` (in `_Plant_ShowContainer.swift:19`) and `TrackContainerProtocol` (in `_Plant_TrackContainer.swift:19`) share three identical members — `isStale:Bool`, `lastRefreshedAt:Date?`, and `pageToken:String?` — differing only in the `item` slot (`Show` vs `Track`). Introducing a parent protocol `ContainerProtocol` in the same `Playback` package that declares the three shared members eliminates the duplication. Each child protocol then refines `ContainerProtocol` and declares only its specific `item` associated type or property. Both records are production code (`is_test=false`, `is_codegen=false`, `is_mock=false`) in the same package, making consolidation safe and idiomatic.
